_finding: The wall of findings on the landing page (spec 4, 12.11) shows the rows of /api/history/cases. The deployer address is the collector's work and stays out of every public answer; a token's own text never reaches the page's HTML. Each mutation leaks one of them; the untrusted-text tests must notice.

mutations.name: a public case event carries the deployer
mutations.find: kind: e.kind, imitates_symbol: e.registry_symbol ?? null, listed_address: e.registry_address ?? null,
mutations.replace: kind: e.kind, deployer: e.deployer ?? null, imitates_symbol: e.registry_symbol ?? null, listed_address: e.registry_address ?? null,
mutations.expect: FAIL /api/history/cases: no deployer in any event
